# better-chatbot Patterns — portable chatbot implementation patterns from the better-chatbot project

Curated by Skill Harbor — @jackspace's better-chatbot-patterns skill, listed here with credit to its creator (patterns authored by Jeremy Dawes / Jezweb, extracted from the open-source better-chatbot platform at github.com/cgoinglove/better-chatbot): portable, reusable implementation patterns for building AI chatbots in your own projects — not for contributing to better-chatbot itself. It ships 5 pattern families: server action validators (auth, validation, FormData handling with Zod), tool abstraction systems (multi-type tool handling: MCP, Workflow, Default), multi-AI provider setup (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Ollama, OpenRouter), workflow execution patterns, and state management conventions — each with problem statement, solution code templates, and adaptation notes. Honest caveats: the patterns were extracted from a specific project and stack (Next.js 15, Vercel AI SDK 5, Zod 3.24, Zustand 5) — adaptation to other stacks is on you; last verified 2025-10-29, so check current library versions. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Discovered via skills.sh.
